site.name: AstPIE
footer.text: AstPIE, the Astrophysics Platform for Interactive Education
home.title: AstPIE
home.tagline: The physics of planets, rockets and stars, explained so it finally makes sense. Play with the laws in simulations, then follow the real missions that proved them.
home.description: AstPIE is an interactive platform for learning astrophysics: simulations, missions, mysteries and a catalogue of space.
learn.title: Learn
learn.intro: The laws that move everything in the universe, from a sliding box to a spacecraft leaving the Solar System. Each one told as a story, with a simulation you can play with.
simulation.narrowScreen: This simulation works best on a wider screen.
simulation.error: The simulation could not be loaded.
explore.title: Explore
explore.intro: The real story of space: the flights that got us there, the signals nobody can explain, and the strange worlds we have found along the way.
missions.title: Missions
missions.description: The flights that took us to orbit, to the Moon and beyond. Each one told from the first idea to the last signal, with the people who made it happen.
mysteries.title: Mysteries
mysteries.description: Signals, stories and sightings that still have no final answer. For each one, the evidence, every explanation that has been tried, and how likely each one looks today.
catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.description: Stars, planets and black holes, each with the numbers that describe it and the story of how we found it.
unit.sunMasses: times the mass of the Sun
notFound.title: Page not found
home.heading: Look up. Then find out why.
home.learnText: Forces, motion, gravity and light. Every law told as a story you can follow, with a simulation you control and examples from real space flight.
home.exploreText: The real story of space. The missions that got there, the mysteries nobody has solved, and a catalogue of the stars, planets and black holes we have found.
learn.readText: Every law starts with an everyday puzzle and builds up to the law itself, in plain words first and in maths second.
learn.playText: Each law has a simulation. Change the forces and the masses, and watch what the law predicts actually happen.
learn.spaceText: Every law ends with real missions that depend on it, linked to their full stories in Explore.
explore.missionsText: From a beeping metal ball in 1957 to a probe that has left the Solar System. Every flight told from the first idea to its last signal.
explore.mysteriesText: Signals, stories and sightings that still have no final answer. Every explanation laid out, with the evidence for and against.
explore.catalogueText: Stars, planets and black holes, with the numbers that describe them and the stories of how we found them.
explore.timelineTitle: The space age, year by year
explore.timelineText: Each dot is a mission. Choose a country to see its flights.
explore.startText: One flight, one signal and one world, each a good first read.
entry.physicsText: The law of physics this story depends on, explained with a simulation.
radio.help: Turn the dial slowly, the way radio amateurs did in 1957. Sputnik is somewhere on this band, on two frequencies.
decoder.title: Decode it yourself
decoder.help: Click a column to read it. Each one is twelve seconds of the signal, in order, as the sky drifted past the telescope.
decoder.result: From {t}, the signal was {v} times stronger than the background hiss of space.
